customer.label: CUSTOMER
customer.descriptor: friendly woman, slim build, short brown hair, mustard-yellow coat, red scarf, canvas tote bag; full body

euro_coins.label: EURO_COINS
euro_coins.descriptor: a euro banknote and a couple of coins lying naturally on a small shop change tray, as on a shop counter; the banknote is marked with the € euro symbol, and each coin is stamped with the cent symbol (¢) only — no digits, numbers, denominations, or any other markings on the coins or the note

price_tag.label: PRICE_TAG
price_tag.descriptor: a small blank paper price tag on a short string

doorway.label: DOORWAY
doorway.descriptor: a simple generic shop entrance with a plain glass door in a warm wooden frame, no signage or branding, viewed head-on

coffee.label: COFFEE
coffee.descriptor: a single cup of coffee on a saucer

loaf.label: LOAF
loaf.descriptor: a single rustic oval loaf of bread

rolls.label: ROLLS
rolls.descriptor: exactly two round bread rolls, side by side

ground_meat.label: GROUND_MEAT
ground_meat.descriptor: a single portion of fresh pink-red minced meat on a sheet of white butcher paper

scale.label: SCALE
scale.descriptor: a round dial weighing scale with an empty metal pan on top above the dial, a single needle, the face marked in grams in increments of 100 around its edge

beef_icon.label: BEEF_ICON
beef_icon.descriptor: a simple flat cow icon — a single-colour cow silhouette like the stamp printed on beef packaging, not a realistic animal

tablets.label: TABLETS
tablets.descriptor: a single blister pack of round white tablets in a silver foil sheet

counter.label: COUNTER
counter.descriptor: a plain wooden shop counter, seen head-on, nothing on it

espresso_machine.label: ESPRESSO_MACHINE
espresso_machine.descriptor: a chrome espresso machine, the kind on a café back counter

display_shelves.label: DISPLAY_SHELVES
display_shelves.descriptor: plain empty wooden wall shelves, the kind behind a shop counter

display_case.label: DISPLAY_CASE
display_case.descriptor: an empty glass refrigerated display case, the kind behind a shop counter

barista.label: BARISTA
barista.descriptor: friendly woman in her 30s, slim build, brown hair in a ponytail, denim apron over a white tee, warm smile; full body

baker.label: BAKER
baker.descriptor: friendly woman in her 40s, average build, dark hair in a bun, green apron over a striped shirt, warm smile; full body

butcher.label: BUTCHER
butcher.descriptor: friendly man in his 50s, tall and lean, short grey hair, white butcher's coat over a blue-striped apron, warm smile; full body

pharmacist.label: PHARMACIST
pharmacist.descriptor: friendly woman in her 40s, average build, auburn hair tied back, white pharmacist's coat over a light blue blouse, warm smile; full body
